primaryFinding: The 87 held legacy records are a table-projection / missing OCR-cell-binding problem, not a numeric OCR recognition failure in this source page. The PDF-visible 13 affected baselines each contain seven physically separated month cells: 91/91 PDF numeric words match 91/91 raw Paddle OCR tokens in exact text and unique transformed boxes. Across the full table there are 37 seven-cell numeric rows (259 cells), including four separate parenthetical percent-change rows, plus two all-n.a. rows and one six-number-plus-n.a. row. Old source rows merge multiple values, lack per-cell OCR boxes/indexes, and include a one-slot cyclic sequence (row 10), displaced label/value (row 10), absent label record (row 21), and next-section heading in a value field (row 20). New PDF/box-derived rows are supported, while old frozen cell records remain held and unchanged.
headerFinding: PDF geometry shows the left-stub divider x=199.34–199.94 pt, data area right edge x=564.0–564.6 pt, seven PDF month-word centers and a 2567 year word centered over the complete month area. There are no internal vertical month rules in the header; slot boundaries are midpoint-derived from PDF header centers, not assumed from Paddle HTML column numbers. Four standalone percent-change lines use the rendered/Paddle delta label (∆%), while PDF text extraction emits (D%); their numeric cells map uniquely, but relation to the preceding line remains adjacency context only.
